_doc: The farm's background sound and music (scripts/soundscape.gd). beds: looping recordings by name. phases: the beds that may play in each part of the day (DayCycle.phase_name), one chosen by the day; seasons: beds kept to those seasons. weather: by weather state, a loop laid over the bed (layer, at layer_db) and how much quieter the bed goes (bed_db). fade: seconds of every cross-fade; check_every: seconds between looks. music: tracks (res:// paths, CC0 or credited), the rest between them (gap: seconds, least and most), the first after start (first_after), gain_db.
